sections.heading: open.games
sections.subheading: A game engine and kit for card, board and table-sport games, with computer players. Pure functions over plain data, so a game runs the same in a browser, on a server or in a worker.

sections.markdown: New here? Start with [Getting started](/docs/getting-started/), then browse [the 55 games](/docs/games/). Writing one? See [Adding a game](/docs/adding-a-game/) and [the game contract](/docs/game-contract/).
